name: glanceline
description: A status line that adds zero lines: limits with pace and context on Claude Code's hint line, a receipt on every turn that flags the unusual one (a context jump, a cache write, repeated failures), agents and compaction in the footer, heads-up notifications, a details pane.

preset.title: Layout
preset.description: minimal, default or full (adds bars, cost, session time and git; still one line under the prompt)

icons.title: Icons
icons.description: Nerd Font icons before each segment

toasts.title: Heads-up toasts
toasts.description: Toasts in the terminal: before the cache goes cold, when a limit is on pace to run out, repeated tool failures, compaction

notifications.title: Native notifications
notifications.description: Desktop notifications for the high-value heads-ups (cache about to go cold, a usage window reset) so they reach you in another app

receipt.title: Turn receipt
receipt.description: What each turn's closing line adds: adaptive (the cost and cache reads, or what was unusual: a context jump, a large cache write, repeated failures), short (cost, cache, tools), full or off
